archetypes.name: waterfall-routing
archetypes.rationale: Codex-first changes span multiple Bash decision points where stale ordering can silently preserve cursor-first behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every runtime waterfall changed by the diff, especially omitted --coder selection, CI fix vendor rotation, and merge/conflict recovery. Verify the new Codex, then Cursor, then Claude ordering is actually exercised in live paths while explicit --coder behavior and Claude terminal fallback remain unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: rotation-policy
archetypes.rationale: The first-fixer-non-health policy depends on rotated tier position rather than a literal tool name.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the CI-fixer rotation and first-fixer-non-health semantics after the base order flip. Check that attempt offsets, launcher failure classification, health-failure fallthrough, and user-bail behavior still align with the intended rotated-first-tier policy. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: python-parity
archetypes.rationale: The Python port is parity-only but must stay behaviorally aligned with ship-pr shell constants and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the Python fixer tier order and tests against the live Bash ship-pr behavior. Look for derived consumers that might still assume cursor-first ordering, mismatched mock expectations, or comments that would mislead the future Python cutover. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hermetic-harness
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes shell harness stubs intended to prevent lint hangs when external CLIs are present but unavailable.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the test harness changes that prepend stub codex, cursor, and claude binaries. Verify the stubs are scoped to the intended harness, cannot invoke real external tools by accident, preserve the behaviors the tested script expects, and do not mask failures unrelated to external availability. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-topology
archetypes.rationale: The change is documentation-heavy and stale routing prose can become an operator-facing defect.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the updated documentation and prompt surfaces for consistency with the new Codex-first defaults and the unchanged explicit-coder behavior. Include the Claude auth guidance, security posture text, routing tables, changelog/version metadata, and any planned surfaces that appear changed outside the stated scope. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
